faqs.question: How much does flea treatment cost in Jamaica, Queens?
faqs.answer: The cost of flea treatment in Jamaica depends on the size of your property, the severity of the infestation, and the treatment method required. Contact us at (855) 930-5016 for a free, no-obligation phone quote with no hidden fees.

faqs.question: How long does flea treatment take to work?
faqs.answer: You'll notice a significant reduction in flea activity within 24-48 hours of treatment. Complete elimination typically takes 2-3 weeks as our treatment targets fleas at all life stages, including eggs and larvae. We often recommend a follow-up treatment for severe infestations.

faqs.question: Is flea treatment safe for my pets and children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use EPA-registered products that are safe for pets and children when applied by a Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator. We recommend keeping pets and children away from treated areas for 2-4 hours while the treatment dries, after which the space is completely safe.

faqs.question: Do I need to prepare my Jamaica home before flea treatment?
faqs.answer: We recommend vacuuming all carpets and floors, washing pet bedding, and temporarily removing pets during treatment. Our technicians will provide detailed preparation instructions when scheduling your appointment to ensure the most effective results.
